title: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
summary: A Hacker News discussion sparked by a Meta engineer's concerns about shipping AI-generated code that developers don't fully understand, expressing discomfort with the 'black box' nature of AI-assisted development and the tension between speed and code comprehension.
problem_solved: Raises awareness about the professional responsibility and quality assurance challenges developers face when increasingly relying on AI-generated code.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical emerging concern in software engineering about maintaining code quality, security, and developer accountability in the age of AI-assisted development.
